prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured reports vehicle was turning left at an intersection when it was struck on the driver side by a vehicle proceeding straight. Insured states the light had changed. Photos requested from insured and scene.

Entry 2: Claimant contacted by phone. Reports neck and lower back pain following impact and was evaluated at an urgent care clinic. Claimant states they are not represented by an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly. Advised of right to seek counsel.

Entry 3: Obtained statement from the other driver. Driver maintains the turning vehicle entered the intersection on a yellow signal. Discrepancy noted between the two accounts. Requested intersection camera footage from the municipality.

Entry 4: Reviewed property damage estimate for both vehicles. Insured vehicle assessed as a total loss pending appraisal. Claimant vehicle has moderate rear-quarter damage. Medical records requested from claimant, including treatment notes for back strain and prescribed physical therapy plan.

Entry 5: Received partial police report listing the turning vehicle as at fault based on driver statements. Liability position remains under review pending footage. Claimant's injury file open for back strain; will reassess once medical documentation is complete and a settlement evaluation is scheduled.
